svg.aria-label: Model fallback switchboard for the 13 November 2026 Claude outage. A CLAUDE API cell on the left has a tripped breaker and a dead lamp; a BACKUP MODEL cell on the right is lit. The big knife-switch lever is thrown over onto the backup contact, the queue drum holds the pending requests, and the status dial's needle sits in the orange zone. Numbers from the incident: 2 outages, API down 2 hours 29 minutes, auth down 2 hours, scheduled tasks more than 2 hours late.
